original_test_intent: Demonstrate functional SPI communication on the physical QSPI0 link from the BMC to the CEC1736 BMC EROT, including an identifiable request/response or other approved transaction that meets the platform's electrical and protocol criteria.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the exact BMC and CEC1736 endpoints and QSPI0 probe points, establishes the approved bus voltage, mode, clock and transaction oracle, safely connects a calibrated high-impedance logic analyzer/oscilloscope or invokes a vendor-authorized internal EROT diagnostic, captures a complete target-bound exchange, correlates it with BMC/EROT state and logs, then removes probes and restores the known-good state without writes, firmware changes, resets or automatic retry.
manual_activity: A qualified operator/vendor selects the approved QSPI0 probe points, attaches a calibrated high-impedance instrument, captures and decodes the BMC-to-CEC1736 exchange, documents the setup, and safely removes the probes; alternatively the vendor runs its approved internal diagnostic.
required_inputs: BMC and CEC1736 BMC EROT identities, schematic/revision and exact QSPI0 probe map
Approved SPI voltage, mode, clock, chip-select, transaction/handshake and timing acceptance oracle
Calibrated instrument/probe loading limits or signed vendor internal diagnostic procedure
Maintenance state, probe attach/remove procedure, abort thresholds and BMC/EROT recovery
safety_requirements: Use only approved, accessible test points and a calibrated high-impedance probe rated for the QSPI0 electrical domain
Do not short, load, drive or hot-plug an unapproved node; never inject transactions or perform SPI writes autonomously
Do not change BMC/EROT firmware, reset either endpoint or clear diagnostic evidence
Stop on unsafe probe access, voltage/timing anomaly, BMC/EROT fault, management loss or ambiguous chip-select/transaction identity
No automatic repeat or recovery action
agent_execution_scope: Verify identities, schematic revision, QSPI0 mapping, electrical/protocol oracle, instrument calibration and maintenance approval
Guide evidence capture and correlate decoded frames with the named BMC/CEC1736 endpoints and preserved logs
Accept a vendor internal diagnostic only if its coverage and signed/raw output prove the same QSPI0 handshake
Do not claim an SSH inventory check proves the bus, attach probes, drive SPI, alter firmware, reset hardware or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve BMC/CEC1736 identities, QSPI0 probe points, electrical limits, SPI configuration and handshake oracle
Approve operator/instrument or internal-diagnostic procedure, aborts and recovery
Review waveform/decoded-frame or signed diagnostic evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Qualified operator performs the approved QSPI0 capture and decode, or vendor executes an explicitly equivalent BMC-internal EROT diagnostic; retain raw waveform/frames and endpoint logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC-to-CEC1736 QSPI0 scope, AI_VR_SPI_BMC_and_BMCEROT bundle and 10/10-minute allocation remain; mode, clock and thresholds are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM MANUAL BMC-TO-CEC1736 QSPI0 FUNCTIONAL AND ELECTRICAL CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture an identified, complete BMC/CEC1736 QSPI0 transaction with calibrated passive instrumentation and compare decoded protocol plus voltage/timing against the approved oracle; use a vendor internal diagnostic only with equivalent traceable coverage.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds revision-bound probe points, SPI configuration, electrical loading controls, transaction identity, raw capture retention and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Software inventory may show both endpoints without proving QSPI0 signal integrity, chip-select behavior or a successful exchange; an unbound waveform may belong to another QSPI device.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect probing can load or short a security-critical boot/EROT bus and disrupt management or root-of-trust operation.

project_override_considerations: A signed vendor internal diagnostic may replace external probing only when its documented coverage proves the named QSPI0 path and exposes raw/result evidence. Host or BMC inventory alone is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, board revisions and BMC/CEC1736 identities
Approved QSPI0 schematic/probe map, instrument serial/calibration/settings or internal-diagnostic version/hash
Setup photos and complete raw waveform with decoded chip-select/clock/data frames, or signed diagnostic output
Measured voltage, clock, mode, timing and handshake comparison against the oracle
Pre/post BMC/EROT health, console/SEL/log evidence and restored probe-free state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and bundle consistently target functional BMC-to-CEC1736 communication over QSPI0.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SPI link and functional objective are clear. Operator, probe map, instrument/diagnostic and acceptance oracle are supplyable manual prerequisites.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2164 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00051-V002: approve BMC/CEC1736 EROT identities and QSPI0 probe map; bus voltage, SPI mode, clock/chip-select, expected transaction/handshake and timing limits; calibrated high-impedance instrument or equivalent signed internal diagnostic; safe attach/remove procedure, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Turns a generic successful-handshake statement into endpoint-bound protocol and electrical evidence while protecting the security-critical QSPI0 bus from unsafe probing or active stimulus.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source explicitly requires measuring QSPI0 from the BMC to CEC1736. That is physical signal coverage, not merely device enumeration. Valid evidence must bind chip select and decoded frames to the CEC1736 and confirm voltage, mode, clock and timing; otherwise activity from another target or probe-induced corruption could be misread as success. Because instrument placement and bus access are physical and delicate, the case remains MANUAL ONLY even if a software tool helps decode the capture.
